title: OweHub READ DESC
features:
1 Copy the script.
2 Paste it into your executor.
3 Verify on Discord (instructions in the script).
4 Enjoy!

🔥 Automation
🔄 Auto Rebirth: Automatically rebirths to farm wins efficiently.
Delay Slider: Customize the speed of rebirths.
Rebirth Once: Manually trigger a single rebirth.
🎒 Auto Upgrade Carry: Automatically buys carry capacity upgrades.
⚡ Auto Buy Speed: Automatically purchases speed upgrades.
Custom Amount: Choose how much speed to buy at once.
📍 Teleports
🏠 Base & Spawn: Instantly teleport to your base or the spawn area.
🌍 Area Teleports: Fast travel to all major zones:
Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic, Secret, Celestial, Godly.
🧠 Brainrot Spawns:
Smart Dropdown: Automatically detects and lists all spawned Brainrots.
Teleport: Instantly warp to any selected Brainrot to collect it.
🛠️ Misc Features
🌋 Delete Lava: Removes lava from the game to make survival easier (client-side).
🚪 Remove VIP Doors: Walk through VIP doors without buying gamepasses.
⚡ Instant Proximity: Sets all interaction hold times to 0 for instant pickup/interaction.
🏃 Player Stats
💨 WalkSpeed: Set your custom walk speed.
🐰 JumpPower: Set your custom jump height.
Force Modes: Toggles to constantly enforce your speed/jump settings.
